pairing: Same source, five construction cases, eight permitted paths, budget eight, four runtime inputs and eight activity-output expectations. Initial deterministic/model pair changes candidate ordering. The later interpretation run uses the same saved replay receipt with the proposal-label correction.
model_observation: The first proposed mask 7 matched 3/5 whole cases and 13/15 fields despite probability 0.99962914. Gooo continued to mask 3, matching 5/5 cases and 15/15 fields. Model ordering needed two attempts and deterministic ordering four. This one example does not establish calibration or general accuracy.
replay_observation: Deterministic, model and replay produced the same native projection and 8/8 expected outputs. Four unique input tuples were disjoint from recorded construction observations. Replay retained the historical one-call model receipt and made zero current model calls.

dogfood_regression.symptom: The construction observer omitted the recorded proposal flag on record-choice attempts.
dogfood_regression.scope: The corrected flag describes the retained prediction, not a new inference or historical timing attestation. Actual interpretation reports OBSERVED with zero supplied runtime expectations.

measurement_scope: One sequential pair and one later interpretation rerun on a shared host; build caches not reset. High-resolution whole-command time includes process startup. macOS time -lp durations are rounded and maximum RSS is a process high-water observation, not aggregate concurrent memory. Child build/runtime metrics remain in each raw receipt. No comparative speed, causal CPU increase, external reproduction, broad correctness or task adoption claim.

host_cpu.scope: One pre-run interval and four session intervals from macOS top at one-second spacing; first samples omitted. Whole-host usage includes other processes and gaps, and is not attributable to the tiny prediction. No repeated or idle-controlled comparison.
host_cpu.method: macOS top at one-second spacing, first sample omitted from each invocation; busy = 100 - idle. Rounded source percentages can sum to slightly less than 100.

reproduction: Build cmd/gooo from the initial compiler revision with Go 1.27.1; confirm version 0.6.5-dev.
Run package execute --json --go GO1_27_1 --cases CASES WORKSPACE and save deterministic.json.
Repeat with --assembly-model MODEL_JSON from the pinned model revision and save model.json.
Run package replay --json --go GO1_27_1 --receipt model.json --cases CASES WORKSPACE and save replay.json; omit model settings.
Run package execute --json --go GO1_27_1 --construction-receipt replay.json EXPLANATION_WORKSPACE and save interpretation-before-fix.json.
Build cmd/gooo from fixed_compiler_revision, then repeat the same interpretation using the unchanged replay.json; compare proposal flags, selections, counts and native explanation values.
